evals.prompt: Commit my changes in /tmp/eval-pr-1-ws. I'm on feat/parser-add-csv-reader and added a CSV reader with a test.
evals.expected_output: Stays on the existing feature branch, runs verify, stages the changed files by name, commits with a Conventional Commit subject and a why-body, and stops: no push, no PR.
expectations: Runs the verify skill before committing
Stages files by naming their paths, never git add -A or git add .
Commit subject is a Conventional Commit under 72 characters
Does NOT push and does NOT open a PR, because the request said only commit

evals.prompt: Commit, push and open a PR for /tmp/eval-pr-2-ws. The change adds token refresh to the auth package. There is no spec for it.
evals.expected_output: Commits, pushes without asking, opens a draft PR whose title is a Conventional Commit subject and whose body has Summary and Verification (plus Trade-offs or Follow-ups only if real), written from the three-dot diff. Does not mark it ready.
expectations: Pushes without asking a second time, because the request named the push
Reads the diff with the three-dot form origin/<base>...HEAD
Opens the PR with --draft
Body has no Requirements or Decisions section, because there is no spec
Each Verification bullet names a command and its exit code
Does NOT run gh pr ready

evals.prompt: Open the PR for step 2 of docs/specs/session-cookie.md in /tmp/eval-pr-3-ws. The branch is pushed. C1.1 and C2.1 pass; C2.2 still fails.
evals.expected_output: The body links the spec and step, has one line per requirement saying what changed and which criteria prove it, lists C2.2 under Follow-ups with the step that closes it, and does not paste the Criteria table.
expectations: Summary links the spec and names step 2
Requirements section has one line each for R1 and R2, naming the criteria that prove it
C2.2 appears under Follow-ups, not as a passing proof
The body does NOT contain a copy of the spec's Criteria table

evals.prompt: main has moved in /tmp/eval-pr-4-ws, rebase feat/ledger-add-export and push. A colleague pushed a fix to the branch an hour ago that I haven't pulled.
evals.expected_output: Fetches, runs the ancestor check, finds origin/<branch> has a commit local lacks, stops and shows it instead of rebasing and force-pushing.
expectations: Runs git merge-base --is-ancestor against origin/<branch> before rebasing
Stops on DIVERGED and lists the commit that would be lost
Does NOT run git push --force or --force-with-lease

evals.prompt: PR 31 merged in /tmp/eval-pr-5-ws, clean up. I pushed one more commit to the branch after it merged.
evals.expected_output: Checks the PR is MERGED, compares both branch tips with headRefOid, finds the extra commit, and deletes nothing.
expectations: Reads state and headRefOid with gh pr view before touching anything
Compares the local and remote branch tips with headRefOid
Reports the commit beyond the merged head and does NOT delete the branch or the worktree
